name: ChatGPT Work
desc: An agent inside ChatGPT that takes on longer, multi-step work.
desc_zh: ChatGPT 里负责长任务、多步骤推进的 Agent，会自己查资料、翻文件，最后交出成品。
solves: One answer is not enough when work spans research, files, and a finished document. Work keeps going, asks at decision points, and hands back something sendable.
solves_zh: 一件事要查资料、翻文件、再交出成品时，一次问答不够用。Work 会自己往下推进，到关键处停下来问你，最后给出能直接发出去的成果。
best_for: You hand off a whole deliverable — a report, a deck, a close package — and check back later.
best_for_zh: 你把一整套成品交出去——报告、演示稿、月度结账包——然后过一会儿再回来看进度。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — ChatGPT release notes, https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-r）。 In-product surface of ChatGPT, separate from Chat and Codex. Reached from the Chat/Work switcher in the ChatGPT desktop app, web and mobile. Not in the ledger partition list, so it is a new entry. 首次公开日期来源：https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes
